name: Shiratori Joji
source:
A genderless detective in charge of disguise.

He loves beautiful things, but hates his own face.

He proclaims that "makeup is a gentle magic that bridges the gap between your ideal self and reality."

He doesn't like exercise, but he's actually quite strong.

He's a skinny, big eater and quick eater, and can apparently finish off large amounts of food with style.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/joji]Official site[/url]]
